content: प्रचलित (प्रचलत्) {%a.%} .²1 Shaken, moved, set in motion. .²2 Moving about; एतस्मिन् प्रचलाकिनां प्रचलतामुद्वेजिताः कूजितैः <ls>U. 2. 29</ls>. .²3 Wandering, roaming. .²4 Having set out or proceeded. .²5 Customary, recognized or received as authority. .²6 Current, prevalent. .²7 confused, bewildered. .{@-तम्@} Going away, departure.
